_meta.status: read by the generator (name, description, flavor); written by an AI; text pass of 2026-11-25
_meta.keyed_by: The plant's English name exactly as CONTENT.md lists it.

vanilla_loc_pattern.name: NaturalResource.<Id>.DisplayName
vanilla_loc_pattern.description: NaturalResource.<Id>.Description (the field exists on LabeledEntitySpec; vanilla plants leave it empty)
vanilla_loc_pattern.keyword_line: NaturalResources.Aquatic / NaturalResources.Arid, shown by the game on the planting tooltip
vanilla_loc_pattern.numbers: The game prints growth time and drought resistance itself (Growing.Time, NaturalResources.DroughtResistance, NaturalResources.OverwateringResistance). No number is written into these strings.

suggested_mod_key_pattern.name: Pandaborn.NaturalResource.<Id>.DisplayName
suggested_mod_key_pattern.note: <Id> is the 'id' field without its Pandaborn prefix.

field_rules.name: Title Case, as vanilla writes plants ('Chestnut Tree', 'Coffee Bush').
field_rules.description: What it is and what it gives, then the one soil fact a player must know. Under 100 characters: vanilla plants have no description at all, and the game prints growth time and drought resistance itself.
field_rules.soil_rule: Not shipped. The soil rule on its own, for a planting-tool line or overlay if one is ever added.
field_rules.soil_keyword: The id of the keyword line in 'keywords' below that belongs on this plant.

_meta.death_and_status_lines: Vanilla lines for drying out, overwatering, flooding and contamination are reused as they are. The Great Flowering's lines are in enUS_PandabornEvents.csv.

keywords._note: Written in the form of the vanilla lines NaturalResources.Aquatic and NaturalResources.Arid. 'dry_ground' may replace the vanilla Arid line on Inkpaw plants only if it is shown through its own key; the vanilla Arid key is shared by every faction.

moist_ground.text: <YellowHighlight>Moist ground:</YellowHighlight> Grows on irrigated, green land.

dry_ground.text: <YellowHighlight>Dry ground only:</YellowHighlight> Wet roots kill it.

flooded.text: <YellowHighlight>Flooded field:</YellowHighlight> Must stand in shallow water, up to one block deep.

Shoot bamboo.name: Shoot Bamboo
Shoot bamboo.description: A fast field crop for the Farmhouse. Its shoots can be eaten raw. Survives a short drought.
Shoot bamboo.soil_rule: Moist ground. Survives a short drought.
Shoot bamboo.flavor: It grows fast enough to watch, and several pandas do.

Timber bamboo.name: Timber Bamboo
Timber bamboo.description: A fast tree, cut for poles. Bamboo mushrooms grow in standing groves. Survives a short drought.
Timber bamboo.soil_rule: Moist ground. Survives a short drought.
Timber bamboo.flavor: Tall, straight and hollow. The village is built from it, and so is most of the furniture.

Cabbage.name: Cabbage
Cabbage.description: A sturdy field crop, eaten raw or pickled. Lasts longer without water than shoot bamboo.
Cabbage.soil_rule: Moist ground. Lasts longer without water than shoot bamboo.
Cabbage.flavor: Round, patient and difficult to upset. The Inkpaws feel a certain kinship.

Rice.name: Rice
Rice.description: A grain for the Paddy House. Must stand in water no deeper than one block, and dies quickly if the field dries. Steamed, or pounded into rice flour.
Rice.soil_rule: Flooded field only: water no deeper than one block. Dies quickly if the field dries.
Rice.flavor: From the hillside, the paddies look like mirrors. From inside the paddies, it is mostly mud.

Tea bush.name: Tea Bush
Tea bush.description: A bush planted by the Forester and picked by gatherers. Dry ground only: wet roots kill it.
Tea bush.soil_rule: Dry ground only: wet roots kill it.
Tea bush.flavor: The best leaves grow on the driest slope. The tea pickers mention this on every climb.

Sichuan pepper.name: Sichuan Pepper
Sichuan pepper.description: A spice bush for hot pot, planted by the Forester and picked by gatherers. Dry ground only.
Sichuan pepper.soil_rule: Dry ground only: wet roots kill it.
Sichuan pepper.flavor: It does not burn the tongue. It makes the tongue forget where it is.

Persimmon tree.name: Persimmon Tree
Persimmon tree.description: A fruit tree. Gatherers pick its persimmons again and again, and it gives logs when cut.
Persimmon tree.soil_rule: Moist ground. Tolerates a long dry spell.
Persimmon tree.flavor: The fruit ripens after the leaves have fallen, so the bare tree seems hung with small lanterns.

Flowering shoot bamboo.name: Flowering Shoot Bamboo
Flowering shoot bamboo.description: Bears bamboo seed for a few days and then dies.
Flowering shoot bamboo.flavor: It flowers once in many years. Every plant in the land flowers with it.
Flowering shoot bamboo.note: The one source of these three texts since 2026-11-25 (the copies in enUS_PandabornEvents.csv were removed).

Flowering timber bamboo.name: Flowering Timber Bamboo
Flowering timber bamboo.description: Bears bamboo seed for a few days and then dies.
Flowering timber bamboo.flavor: The grove flowers all at once, as it has for longer than anyone remembers.
Flowering timber bamboo.note: The one source of these three texts since 2026-11-25.

vanilla_plants_kept._note: Birch, pine, oak and blueberries remain and keep their vanilla names. Their vanilla flavor lines quote beaver characters or are neutral; replacements are offered below for an Inkpaws-scoped key and can be ignored.

Birch.flavor: White bark with black marks. The Inkpaws approve of the colors.

Pine.flavor: Green all winter and in no hurry. The Inkpaws consider it a sensible tree.

Oak.flavor: Slow to grow and worth the wait. The Inkpaws respect both.

Blueberry.flavor: The first food of every new village, and the first to be forgotten once the rice comes in.
